title: P03CompleteV1
description: K0→K1 SSE event payload: P03 consolidation cycle completion. Mirrors the K0-internal ``p03.consolidation.complete.v1`` outbox topic on the cross-kernel surface; lets K1 react (e.g. invalidate concierge caches, refresh KG-derived facts) without polling.

envelope_id.description: Per-event ULID. Used as the SSE Last-Event-ID cursor token.

completed_at_utc_ms.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the cycle completed.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the consolidation cycle.

atoms_consolidated.description: Number of atoms folded into long-term memory this cycle.

gaps_emitted.description: Number of p03.gap.detected.v1 events emitted during this cycle.
